headline: BCE sees parallels between the AI debt boom and the dot-com and subprime bubbles
summary: The ECB's latest Financial Stability Review compares AI-related borrowing to the dot-com and subprime episodes. It expects cumulative capital spending by large US technology companies to reach about $5.5 trillion by 2030.
why: The ECB is the central bank of the euro area and publishes assessments of systemic financial risk. Heavy borrowing to fund AI infrastructure is a concern for credit markets and for investors exposed to big technology firms.
original_headline: BCE ve paralelismos entre el auge del endeudamiento de la IA y las burbujas puntocom y subprime
